rows.label: No Time to Die
rows.description: 2021 film directed by Cary Joji Fukunaga
rows.hook: closes out one actor's run as the secret agent with a farewell mission

rows.label: Casino Royale
rows.hook: reboots the franchise with the agent's first mission as a double-0, built around a high-stakes poker game

rows.label: Skyfall
rows.hook: sends the agent to his ancestral Scottish home for a showdown with a former colleague turned cyber-terrorist

rows.label: Octopussy
rows.hook: sends the agent to India and ends with him dressed as a clown, racing to defuse a bomb at a circus

rows.label: Spectre
rows.hook: opens with a Day of the Dead parade in Mexico City and reveals the shadowy group behind earlier villains

rows.label: GoldenEye
rows.hook: opens with a bungee jump off a huge dam and features a rogue satellite weapon

rows.label: Die Another Day
rows.hook: features an invisible car and a villain's palace built from ice

rows.label: Licence to Kill
rows.hook: has the agent go rogue to avenge a friend who was fed to a shark by a drug lord

rows.label: Quantum of Solace
rows.hook: picks up right after the previous film, with the agent chasing a plot to control Bolivia's water

rows.label: A View to a Kill
rows.hook: pits the agent against a microchip tycoon who plans to wipe out Silicon Valley

rows.label: The World Is Not Enough
rows.hook: features an oil heir, a villain who cannot feel pain, and a boat chase along the Thames

rows.label: Tomorrow Never Dies
rows.hook: pits the agent against a media mogul who stirs up conflict to boost his news ratings

rows.label: Never Say Never Again
rows.hook: is a rival studio's remake of an earlier adventure, made outside the main film series

rows.label: The Living Daylights
rows.hook: starts with a defecting Soviet general and a cellist caught up in a sniper plot

rows.label: Dr. No
rows.hook: launched the whole film series, with a metal-handed villain on a Caribbean island

rows.label: On Her Majesty's Secret Service
rows.hook: is the only entry in which the agent gets married, set partly at a Swiss mountaintop lair

rows.label: Goldfinger
rows.hook: introduces the ejector-seat Aston Martin and a villain with a plot against Fort Knox

rows.label: For Your Eyes Only
rows.hook: has the agent race to recover a missile-targeting device from a sunken surveillance ship

rows.label: Live and Let Die
rows.hook: pits the agent against a Harlem drug lord, with a bayou boat chase and a theme by a former Beatle

rows.label: The Spy Who Loved Me
rows.hook: introduces a steel-toothed giant henchman and a car that turns into a submarine

rows.label: From Russia with Love
rows.hook: features a deadly fight aboard a famous luxury train and a stolen code machine

rows.label: Diamonds Are Forever
rows.hook: is set largely in Las Vegas, where the agent chases a gem-smuggling ring

rows.label: You Only Live Twice
rows.hook: takes the agent to Japan, where a villain hides a rocket base inside a volcano

rows.label: Thunderball
rows.hook: revolves around two stolen nuclear bombs and underwater battles in the Bahamas

rows.label: The Man with the Golden Gun
rows.hook: pits the agent against a hired assassin with a custom weapon in a duel on a tropical island

rows.label: Moonraker
rows.hook: takes the agent into outer space to stop a tycoon's orbital plot
